websiteEvidence.evidence: Frontend directory should use the attributable WaultFinance/WAULT source repository, not a historical swap domain. GitHub profile identifies Wault Finance and links wault.finance and @Wault_Finance; surviving legacy links/transparency pages link this GitHub account. The 2021 Inspex WSwap audit independently cites this exact repository with pinned WEX/WexMaster source. Repository is reachable and informational; its current listed contracts do not include this router, so it is not substituted as router ABI/source evidence.
limitations: Current wault.finance documentation is served as WordPress-rendered legacy GitBook content. Domain continuity/ownership and a functioning swap frontend are not established; do not advertise it as a live swap application.
A reachable repository/profile is attribution evidence, not a safety guarantee. No wallet connection or transaction was exercised.

constructorDependencies.evidence: Exact-address Sourcify creation constructorArguments and reported runtime immutable transformation values bind factory and WBNB; reviewed source marks both immutable. Factory equals WS Factory in legacy transparency mapping and exact-address audit scope. No live RPC query was performed.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Legacy Wault transparency Contract Addresses explicitly maps WS Router to this exact BscScan address and WS Factory to its constructor factory. Published Inspex WSwap audit AUDIT2021001 v2.0, issued 2021-05-20, page 4 identifies WSwap as BSC and binds WswapV2Router02.sol to this exact target (name differs from deployed compilation name WaultSwapRouter). Independently indexed BscScan title labels exact target Wault Finance: WS Router. Sourcify chain56 supplies deployment, full ABI/source and reports direct non-proxy resolution.
limitations: Direct BscScan request returned HTTP 403; its indexed exact-address title was retrieved by web search. ABI/source came from the exact-address source service, not the explorer page or a generic fork.
Historical docs/audit establish attribution, not a fresh operational or audit-safety endorsement. No current live bytecode, dependency configuration, balances or liquidity were checked.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full original ABI copied from exact chain56/address Sourcify record. Complete flattened deployed source reviewed, including WaultSwapLibrary, SafeMath, TransferHelper, interfaces and all router methods. Full original selected fragments retained without generic Uniswap/fork ABI substitution. Source service actually reports exact_match for creation and runtime; these labels are preserved, not inferred from match. No fresh runtime RPC attestation or official-repository byte identity is claimed.

sourceSemantics.swapFeeFormula: Library multiplies input by 998 with denominator reserveIn * 1000 + amountInWithFee; exact-output calculation divides by (reserveOut - amountOut) * 998 and adds one. This records reviewed router arithmetic, not current pair economics or financial safety.
sourceSemantics.nativeSettlement: WETH is constructor-bound canonical BSC WBNB. Native-input calls wrap BNB; native-output calls unwrap WBNB and transfer BNB. receive accepts only WETH sender. addLiquidityETH and swapETHForExactTokens refund unused BNB to caller.
sourceSemantics.routing: Explicit address[] token paths determine CREATE2 pairs from immutable factory and fixed deployed init-code hash; addLiquidity can create a missing pair. Both swap loops call pair.swap with empty bytes. No configurable mining hook or external arbitrary executor occurs in this deployed router.
sourceSemantics.liquidityMinimums: _addLiquidity skips both minimum checks for both-zero reserves; otherwise checks only optimized-side minimum in the selected branch. There is no minimum LP minted. Removal checks pair burn-reported outputs after burning, not final post-tax receipt.
sourceSemantics.feeOnTransfer: Supporting token/token and BNB/token swaps check recipient balance increase. Supporting token/BNB swap checks and unwraps whole router WBNB balance. Supporting token/BNB removal forwards whole router token balance and only burn-accounting minimums are checked.
sourceSemantics.dependencies: Reviewed flattened dependency implementations are authoritative for pair derivation, arithmetic and token transfers. Pair/factory/wrapped-native/token runtime code, liquidity and nonstandard behavior were not independently live-attested.
sourceSemantics.nonFunctionEntries: One constructor and one receive are retained in full ABI but create no capabilities; no fallback entry exists.
sourceSemantics.limitations: This file preserves offline inventory evidence only; runtime consumes the generated catalog, not source snapshots. v1 is the catalog version identity, not a claim about original source filename/product version. No fresh runtime identity, liquidity or execution attestation is implied.

functionInventory.reason: Exclude read-only getter or quote; not a transaction capability and not a new read API.

Explicit token/token liquidity provision; pulls caller tokens by allowance, derives pair from immutable factory, may create the pair and mints LP to specified recipient. Deadline enforced; minimum checks are branch-dependent and absent for a zero-reserve pair, not unconditional checks on both amounts.

Explicit token/native-BNB liquidity provision; pulls caller tokens, wraps required msg.value through immutable WBNB, mints LP to recipient and refunds unused BNB to caller. ETH ABI names denote BNB here. Deadline enforced; amount minimums retain branch-dependent _addLiquidity semantics.

Explicit non-permit token/token removal; transfers specified caller LP to the derived pair using LP allowance, burns LP to recipient, checks both burn-accounting output minimums and deadline. Minimums are not net post-tax recipient guarantees.

Explicit non-permit token/native-BNB removal; uses caller LP allowance, checks pair-burn minimums/deadline, transfers calculated token amount, unwraps calculated WBNB amount and pays BNB to recipient.
Explicit non-permit fee-supporting token/native-BNB removal; checks pair-burn minimums/deadline but forwards entire router token balance. Token minimum does not guarantee net post-tax receipt.

Explicit exact-output native-BNB/token path swap; requires WBNB path start, enforces deadline and msg.value input ceiling, wraps required input and refunds surplus BNB to caller.
Explicit exact-input native-BNB/token path swap; wraps msg.value, requires WBNB path start, checks calculated output minimum/deadline and pays specified recipient.
Explicit exact-input native-BNB/token fee-supporting path swap; wraps msg.value, requires WBNB path start and deadline, checks recipient output-token balance increase against minimum.
Explicit exact-input token/native-BNB path swap; pulls caller allowance-bounded input, requires WBNB path end, checks calculated minimum/deadline and unwraps calculated WBNB output to recipient.
Explicit exact-input token/native-BNB fee-supporting swap; pulls caller amount, requires WBNB path end and deadline, checks minimum against entire router WBNB balance before unwrapping and payment.

Explicit exact-input token path swap; pulls caller amount using allowance, checks calculated minimum/deadline and derives pair calls from immutable factory, fixed deployed pair-init-code hash and explicit token path.

Explicit exact-input token fee-supporting path swap; pulls caller amount, computes each hop from pair balance minus reserve, checks recipient output-token balance delta against minimum and enforces deadline.
Explicit exact-output token/native-BNB path swap; pulls calculated caller input under maximum, requires WBNB path end and deadline, unwraps specified WBNB output and pays BNB to recipient.
Explicit exact-output token path swap; pulls calculated caller input under maximum and enforces deadline. Pair swaps use empty callback data, not arbitrary nested execution.

selectedFunctions.label: WaultSwap addLiquidity
warnings: Caller chooses token path, recipient, amounts, slippage bounds and deadline. Token/LP balances, allowances and native gas remain caller responsibilities subject to independent controls.
ETH/WETH ABI names refer to native BNB and constructor-bound WBNB on BSC 56. Four payable selected functions can spend msg.value; all nonpayable selected functions require zero native value.

Liquidity-add minimums are branch-dependent: zero-reserve pools use desired amounts without either minimum check; otherwise only the reserve-optimized side minimum is checked. There is no minimum LP-output argument.

Fee-supporting removal transfers the entire router token balance; supporting token-to-native swaps unwrap the entire router WBNB balance. Ordinary burn/swap amount minimums do not universally guarantee net post-tax receipts. Nonstandard, taxed or rebasing tokens can revert or change accounting.

Factory and wrapped-native addresses are immutable in reviewed source; pair addresses use the deployed library CREATE2 hash and swaps pass empty callback data. No multicall, arbitrary executor, signature/permit or administrator capability is selected.
